priorityList: Cast Vampiric Blood if the buff is not already active.
Cast Raise Dead and Dancing Rune Weapon as your primary offensive cooldowns.
Cast Death Strike if the Coagulopathy buff is about to expire.
Cast Death's Caress if Bone Shield is missing, about to expire (less than 1.5s), or has only 1 stack.
Cast Blood Boil if Blood Plague is missing or about to expire (less than 3s).
Cast Death's Caress or Marrowrend if Bone Shield is below 6 stacks.
During Gift of the San'layn, use Heart Strike to maintain Essence of the Blood Queen stacks (under 7) or if the buff is expiring (under 1.5s).
During Gift of the San'layn, cast Death Strike if Runic Power deficit is less than 36.
Cast Death and Decay whenever Crimson Scourge procs.
Cast Heart Strike whenever Vampiric Strike is available.
Cast Death Strike if Runic Power is near maximum (deficit less than 20).
Cast Death Strike as your primary Runic Power spender.
Cast Heart Strike if you have 2 or more Runes available.
Use Blood Boil as a filler when no other priority actions are available.
